patch_description: Instead of enumerating rigid hex-row templates, this approach uses a physical relaxation search: multiple starting configurations (hex grids with random jitter plus fully random starts), then an iterative force-based refinement. Each iteration (1) solves the exact LP for optimal radii given the current centers, (2) computes repulsion forces between circle pairs whose distance constraint is nearly tight and inward forces from nearly-tight walls, (3) moves centers accordingly. This lets the packing deform away from rigid templates toward the true optimum (where variable radii let circles of different sizes interlock), while the LP guarantees exact optimal radii at every step. The LP assembly is vectorized with a sparse matrix for speed, enabling hundreds of relaxation steps within budget. Best (centers, radii) found across all starts and all iterations is returned.
